traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Drive meets imagination. Energy steered by vision and a persuasive, magnetic pull. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of drive and imagination is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Inspiring and persuasive; keep the aim concrete or the drive dissipates.
shadow: Anger and recklessness fused with illusion and escapism, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.

readerCopy.body: You can feel entirely certain that a situation is wrong without having a single actionable clue about how to fix it. When Mars conjuncts Neptune, high emotional conviction meets a total lack of a blueprint, leaving you ready to fight for an objective that keeps shifting shape. Pushing harder will not make a vague target clear. Define the actual problem, establish what is within your control, and pick one concrete step that actually moves the needle instead of just burning off nervous energy.
